pages.title: Shard of Omnipotence
pages.text: A splinter of the Core that made anything. It still remembers how - it has only forgotten what.
What is left of the Core after the Shutdown Sequence. Once the Transcendental is rekindled, the reborn Core's Forge resonates more of them.
Made in $(item)Pleroma Reconstitutor$().$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Echo Lattice, Echo of the Transcendental, Eschaton Cell, Hand of the Demiurge, Rekindled Spark, Seed of Omnipotence.
